title: Should We Pay This Much for Robustness? Efficient Proxy Certificates with Marginal Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2611.08035v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern classifiers remain sensitive to small input perturbations, while strong model-agnostic robustness certificates such as randomized smoothing are often too expensive for deployment, requiring an extensive number (e.g. 2000) of model forward passes per input. We propose a framework that delegates certification to a cheap proxy function while statistically controlling its deviation from the original sound certificate. Given an exchangeable unlabeled calibration set, we tune the proxy via robust conformal risk control to guarantee a bounded marginal (rather than pointwise) false-approval rate: the probability, over future inputs, that the proxy accepts an input whose prediction is flipped due to perturbation. The resulting proxy certificate can be used either as a standalone marginal certificate or as a fallback mechanism that invokes the expensive certificate only when the proxy rejects. translated_title: 我们应该为鲁棒性付出这么多吗？具有边际保证的高效代理证书
translated_abstract: 现代分类器对小的输入扰动仍然敏感，而强大的模型无关鲁棒性证书（如随机平滑）在部署中往往成本过高，每个输入需要大量的模型前向传播次数（例如2000次）。我们提出了一个框架，将认证任务委托给一个廉价的代理函数，同时在统计上控制其与原始可靠证书之间的偏差。给定一个可交换的无标签校准集，我们通过鲁棒共形风险控制来调节代理，以保证有界的边际（而非逐点）错误批准率：即在未来的输入中，代理接受一个其预测因扰动而翻转的输入的概率。所得到的代理证书既可以作为独立的边际证书使用，也可以作为一种后备机制，仅在代理拒绝时才调用昂贵的证书。我们提供了单样本和多样本设定下的（理论保证与实验结果）。
tldr: 提出一种将鲁棒性认证委托给廉价代理函数的框架，借助鲁棒共形风险控制保证有界的边际错误批准率，可独立使用或作为后备机制，大幅降低认证成本。
